args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity):
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Fixed in 2.9.4.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt` to remediate **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected versions are <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0; fixed in 2.9.4 (and 3.1.0).

I chose the minimal bump to 2.9.4 on the same major line to limit risk; 3.1.0 is also available if we later want to move to 3.x.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878` passed.
